# `aitbc agent-comm receive`

Receive queued messages for a receiver agent from the coordinator inbox. Reads ``GET /api/v1/agent/messages/inbox`` — the old ``/v1/agents/{id}/messages`` route does not exist on the coordinator.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm receive [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--receiver-id` | text | — | yes | The Receiver id. |
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Maximum number of messages to return |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet signing the inbox request headers (default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm receive --receiver-id <receiver_id>
```
